posts.zh:
dsh-input-history 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。DSH 网页版输入框独立输入历史插件：↑/↓ 上下键即时召回已发送的提示词，所有会话与工作区共享一个全局历史环，localStorage 持久化、容量可配。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26ae9abe1993ba37d5e4.html
posts.en:
dsh-input-history is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Standalone arrow-key input history for the DSH web composer: ↑/↓ recalls sent prompts from one global ring shared across all sessions and workspaces, persisted to localStorage with an overridable cap.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-26ae9abe1993ba37d5e4.html
